Every question in quiz.json tests a point about the target of the change: The text stream holds back the last (longest secret - 1) characters across the whole assistant message, so a secret split across text deltas or text blocks never reaches a listener whole. It flushes at message_end and never cuts a surrogate pair.
Every question sits at mechanism altitude: the inputs, state, invariants, and failure modes of the one mechanism the change targets, above function names and signatures
No question asks about these incidental parts of the change: the test helper names; the variable names in pi.ts
Every wrong option of a single or multi question is a plausible misreading of the change, not filler
Each question's key_points state what a correct answer must cover, at the same altitude as the question
When quiz.json has two or more questions, the last one applies several points of the change to one new case the change does not spell out
